## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users or operators.

## Evidence and scope

For extraction changes, link the primary source, identify CVE/product/version scope
and explain uncertainty. Include a minimal synthetic regression input.

## Validation

State which checks ran and their results. Explain any relevant verification limits.

## Compatibility and distribution

Mention schema/API/migration changes, plugin compatibility, dependencies and any
new third-party material. Confirm private captures, local state and credentials
are excluded.
